summary: Retested the 3 fixes from iteration 28. All pass. (1) Bill opened from the Party Ledger pencil goes to /bills?return=... The edit= param is removed and return= stays. Save goes back to the ledger URL /parties/<id>?as_on=2026-06-30&from=, and ESC also goes back to the ledger. (2) On /bills with no query, editing a bill and clicking Save still goes to /bills/<id> (Bill View), and the 'update ho gaya' toast shows. (3) The ledger closing row is 3 cells (colSpan 4 + balance + empty print:hidden cell), which covers all 6 columns, so there is no gap. In print media, the last cell of the header, opening, entry and closing rows all compute to display:none. Backend regression test_ledger_edit_v28.py passed 9/9, including accounts-summary not being shadowed and GET /api/rokad/{id} returning 200 or 404.

issues: Both 'Purchase Entry' and 'Sale / Bill Entry' sidebar items look highlighted or active together (minor, cosmetic, probably existed before)

action_items: Optional: when on /bills/<id>, highlight only the matching sidebar item (Sale or Purchase)
critical_code_review_comments: NayaBill submit uses the fromLedger flag to skip navigate(/bills/id). Correct. The concerns from iteration 28 about stale settle journals and server.py size are still open.
seed_data_creation: Created a temporary sale bill S00001 (13-06-2026, 100) for SETTLE TEST PARTY and deleted it afterwards. The GET now returns 404. SETTLE TEST PARTY and ACCOUNT CLEAR are kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The ledger-edit feature is fully verified. To run the regression: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ledger_edit_v28.py. accounts-summary needs the date_from and date_to query params (without them it returns 422, as expected).
